blocker_candidates.note: AEA decryption of the System volume is ALSO required before it can be exposed; both must be solved for a full-root boot. Guest DT declares ans/apcie controllers that must be emulated.

conclusion.reason: The full System volume EXISTS (043-70116-656.dmg.aea, 8.3GB AEA-encrypted), but qemu-sptm exposes zero block storage to the guest. The restore ramdisk boots purely from RAM. Mounting a full root needs (a) an NVMe/ANS block device model wired to darwin.c, and (b) AEA-decrypted System + Cryptex images exposed through it.
